result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and written certification of deletion thereafter. It preserves the existing termination-payment provision. However, it goes beyond the playbook by expressly requiring transfer of the Site and URL and by extending return/deletion obligations to all Content; those additions may be commercially appropriate but are not necessary to satisfy the rule. Drafting is otherwise professional, though the new section numbering may be inconsistent with the existing subsection structure and 'thereafter' does not set a specific deletion deadline.
